title: Vivaan Kapoor Secures India's First LA 2028 Olympic Trap Quota with Silver
indian_angle: Vivaan Kapoor's historic silver medal win at the World Championships has earned India a crucial quota spot for the LA 2028 Olympics in men's trap shooting.
summary: Vivaan Kapoor won a trap silver medal at the World Championships, becoming only the fourth Indian man to medal in the discipline and securing India's first LA 2028 Olympic quota.

title: Om Semwal, Rathika Seelan, Sanya Vats Advance in Singapore Classic Squash
indian_angle: Indian squash players Om Semwal, Rathika Seelan, and Sanya Vats have successfully progressed to the next round of the $15,000 PSA Challenger event in Singapore.
summary: Om Semwal, Rathika Seelan, and Sanya Vats all advanced in the Singapore Classic squash tournament, though Sandhesh Palanivel Ravikumar exited in the opener.

title: Srikanth, Lakshya Advance to Kumamoto Masters Quarterfinals
indian_angle: Top Indian shuttlers Srikanth and Lakshya Sen have made it to the quarterfinals of a prestigious international tournament.
summary: Kidambi Srikanth stunned Kodai Naraoka, while Lakshya Sen defeated Dong Tian Yao, securing their spots in the Kumamoto Masters quarterfinals.

title: Raichandani's 93 Guides India U19 to Asia Cup Final Against Pakistan
indian_angle: India's U19 cricket team, powered by Raichandani's impressive 93 runs, has secured a spot in the Asia Cup final, setting up an exciting clash against arch-rivals Pakistan.
summary: Raichandani's 93-run knock propelled the India U19 team into the Asia Cup final, where they are set to face Pakistan for the title.

title: Ambekar Meetei Wins India's First Youth Olympics Boxing Gold
indian_angle: Ambekar Meetei has made history by winning India's first-ever boxing gold medal at the Youth Olympics 2026, marking a significant achievement for Indian boxing.
summary: Ambekar Meetei secured India's historic first-ever boxing gold medal at the Youth Olympics 2026, surpassing Shiva Thapa's 2010 silver.
